name: Main Street USD
oneLiner: msUSD was Main Street's dollar token; Pharos freezes it after Accountable terminated reserve verification and the token permanently depegged in June 2026.

obituary.epitaph: Verification failed before the dollar did
obituary.obituary: Main Street's msUSD collapsed after Accountable terminated its verification relationship on June 20, 2026, saying the protocol failed verification standards. msUSD fell far below the dollar and remained around $0.29-$0.33 in the following week while independent on-chain analysts reported minimal immediately redeemable reserves against tens of millions of tokens. Main Street disputed the characterization and said assets remained backed, but the combination of failed third-party verification, unresolved redemption capacity, and persistent market pricing made msUSD unsuitable for active stablecoin tracking.

collateral: Main Street docs described msUSD mint/redemption against USDC and strategy assets, but third-party verification was terminated and Pharos no longer treats the reserve base as active, verified dollar backing.
pegMechanism: Formerly redeemed by verified users through capacity-limited USDC withdrawals after a protocol cooldown. Following the June 2026 verification failure and depeg, Pharos treats msUSD as a frozen collapse case rather than an active redeemable dollar.

mintAuthority.summary: MSUSD on Ethereum mints via a configured minter contract (0x70c0c12) owned by a 3/4 Safe; on Sonic, the 3/4 Safe mints directly (minter() = zero). Both Safes share the same 4 signers.

controls.label: MSUSD Ethereum minter contract
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294721, minter() on the MSUSD proxy (0x4ba01f22827018b4772cd326c7627fb4956a7c00) returned 0x70c0c12fbb3acfff8e48abf027436971cf2ade14; that contract's owner() returns 0x0eAe4ACb10f3e5696cF6B0de33693eF8EC571858 (the ETH owner Safe). The minter contract code is 246 bytes (proxy pattern).

controls.label: MSUSD Ethereum owner (3/4 Safe)
controls.evidence: Safe API (eth) confirmed 0x0eAe4ACb10f3e5696cF6B0de33693eF8EC571858 has 4 owners, threshold 3, no modules, zero guard, fallbackHandler 0xfd0732Dc9E303f09fCEf3a7388Ad10A83459Ec99, masterCopy 0x41675C099F32341bf84BFc5382aF534df5C7461a (Safe v1.4.1). eth_getCode confirmed it is a contract (Gnosis proxy bytecode).

controls.label: MSUSD Sonic owner (3/4 Safe)
controls.evidence: Safe API (sonic) confirmed 0x861a58d3DE287196c5546d10c7afFa479E0963e4 has the same 4 owners as the ETH Safe, threshold 3, no modules, zero guard, fallbackHandler 0xfd0732Dc9E303f09fCEf3a7388Ad10A83459Ec99, masterCopy 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762 (Safe L2 v1.4.1). Sonic minter() on the token returns zero address (owner mints directly).

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25294721: MSUSD proxy owner() = 0x0eAe4ACb (3/4 Safe, Safe API confirmed), minter() = 0x70c0c12 (contract, owner = same Safe). Sonic block 73491022: MSUSD proxy owner() = 0x861a58d3 (3/4 Safe, same 4 signers, Safe API sonic confirmed), minter() = 0x0 (direct owner minting). Both Safes: threshold 3, no modules, no guard, known masterCopies.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: MSUSD is deployed on Ethereum and Sonic. Sonic documentation describes Sonic Gateway as the native Ethereum/Sonic bridge, so Pharos treats this as canonical/native gateway route exposure rather than a third-party liquidity bridge.

notices.title: Frozen after June 2026 depeg
notices.message: Accountable terminated Main Street's reserve-verification agreement on June 20, 2026, and msUSD has traded far below $1 since. Main Street disputes the reserve-failure characterization, but Pharos archives msUSD as frozen because independent verification and durable peg behavior failed.
